title: Ethiopian Amete Alem Calendar
intro: Amete Alem is the Ethiopian Year of the World era convention.
structure: The Ethiopian year contains twelve 30-day months and a final month, Pagume, of five days ordinarily or six when the arithmetic year has positive remainder 3 modulo 4.
model: Subtract 5500 from the displayed Amete Alem year to obtain arithmetic year y. For month m and day d, JDN = 1724221 - 1 + 365*(y-1) + floor(y/4) + 30*(m-1) + d. The inverse arithmetic year is floor((4*(JDN-1724221)+1463)/1461); add 5500 for display. The same underlying day has the same month and day in both Ethiopian era conventions.
example: Year 2018 Amete Mihret corresponds to year 7518 Amete Alem on the same month and day.
history: Ethiopian historical and religious references may employ distinct era counts. The era name and date convention must be identified before interpreting such a record.
limits: A separate provider, not an alias of Amete Mihret. Arithmetic continuation does not certify every historical use.
